description: Single source of truth for PushCube benchmark results. All README, BENCHMARK.md, and docs/benchmark_report.md tables should be generated from or consistent with this file.

environment.name: PushCube (dual-cube, language-conditioned)
environment.state_description: arm(x,y), cube1(x,y), cube2(x,y), goal(x,y), cube1_color(r,g), cube2_color(r,g), goal_color_onehot(2)
environment.action_description: [dx, dy] end-effector delta, bounded by arm speed (0.08/step)

evaluation_protocol.task: Same dual-cube PushCube environment for all methods
evaluation_protocol.success_definition: Same: target cube within 0.15 units of goal center
evaluation_protocol.seed_family: 3000-3019 used for SmolVLA and RL evaluation
evaluation_protocol.note: Evaluation episode counts differ by method (see per-method data). This is NOT a strictly controlled leaderboard. Training data, compute, model scale, and evaluation episode counts all vary.
evaluation_protocol.horizon_note: All methods use max_steps=80. SmolVLA eval_results.json confirms max_steps=80 (not 100 as previously stated).

state_bc.note: Proves the unified task is learnable from state alone

rl_ppo.method: BC-initialized PPO (Actor-Critic + GAE + BC pre-training + expert-guided exploration)
rl_ppo.note: BC pre-training reaches 40%, but PPO fine-tuning partially destabilizes policy

vla.note: Needs significantly more data (>1000 episodes) and/or larger model

action_chunking.method: Minimal Action-Chunking Policy (K-frame Transformer, lang-conditioned, temporal ensembling, no CVAE)
action_chunking.note: NOT YET EVALUATED for closed-loop success. Previous reports showing 0% were incorrect.

diffusion.method: Minimal Diffusion Policy (DDPM, action horizon, lang-conditioned, deterministic eval)
diffusion.note: NOT YET EVALUATED for closed-loop success. Previous reports showing 0% were incorrect.

wm_mpc_cem.note: Model prediction error compounds over planning horizon

wm_mpc_random.note: Random shooting cannot find good action sequences

smolvla_500.note: 50% selection accuracy = chance level (model has not learned to use language). Evaluation metrics are retained in the committed summary; the per-episode eval_results.json is not committed.

smolvla_10k.note: Training loss decreased 3x (0.10 -> 0.03) but closed-loop success remains 0%. The committed configuration and summary support aggregate claims; per-step and per-episode raw files are not committed.

summary_table.note: For quick reference — success_rate_pct values. null means NOT YET EVALUATED.

provenance.git_commit_at_creation: unknown; aggregation was created after commit 558e8db but the exact commit was not recorded
provenance.created_by: manual aggregation from pushcube_summary.json plus committed SmolVLA summaries and training configurations
raw_data_sources: results/smolvla/500_steps/summary.md and training_config.json (aggregate SmolVLA 500-step evidence; per-episode eval JSON not committed)
results/smolvla/10k_steps/summary.md and training_config.json (aggregate SmolVLA 10K-step evidence; per-step history and per-episode eval JSON not committed)
